rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an Indian-style curry dish.

example.english: I want to eat curry tonight.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 gaa3 lei1

rows.note: Use this when you mean the spiced curry sauce itself rather than a complete dish.

example.english: This curry sauce is great with rice.
example.jyutping: nei1 di1 gaa3 lei1 zap1 lou1 faan6 jat1 lau4

rows.note: Use this specifically for curry powder.

example.english: Before cooking curry, remember to add curry powder.
example.traditional: 煮咖喱之前，記得落咖喱粉。
example.jyutping: zyu2 gaa3 lei1 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 lok6 gaa3 lei1 fan2
